data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's distinguishing criterion is self-undermining. It claims a checklist 'works by summing features' and may be exploiting a spurious correlation in the evaluation set, and that genuine vs mere compliance is diagnosed by examining failure modes on edge cases. But within *a single evaluation*, observing that a rigid system fails predictably on edge cases while a flexible one fails unpredictably does not separate a genuine reliability gain from mere compliance: a checklist that happens to encode a spurious correlation will also fail *predictably* on the edge cases that break that correlation, so the very signature SRC_002 offers as diagnostic (predictable rigid failure) is equally compatible with mere spurious-correlation compliance. The criterion therefore tracks structural rigidity, not genuineness.
